name: Selfish Ambitions
overview: Scripture warns against selfish ambitions by highlighting the destructive effects of envy, strife, and vainglory, which lead to confusion and evil works. Believers are called to love their neighbors as themselves and to act with humility, esteeming others above themselves rather than pursuing selfish gain. True Christian conduct depends on submitting plans to the Lord’s will, recognizing that human desires must be aligned with His purpose to avoid bitter envy and discord.
